theorems.name: Submission.dohr_local_monotonicity
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → ∀ (y : Amb n ℓ) (R Λ : ℝ), 0 < R → closedBall y R ⊆ U → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ ball y R → ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => V.tangentProj x) (V.weight.restrict (ball y R)) → 0 < Λ → Λ ≤ 1 → V.scaledLpNorm H p y R ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((p - n) / (4 * p) * Λ) → ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, |F r - 1| ≤ Λ ∧ Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ F r ∧ F r ≤ Real.exp Λ) ∧ Tendsto F (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) ∧ MonotoneOn (fun r => F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1) (Ioo 0 R) ∧ ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ V.HasDensity y t ∧ Tendsto (fun r => F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (unitBallVolume n * t))
